{{Recipe}}

== Ingredients ==
* 4 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]] [[Cookbook:Apple|apples]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoon]] [[Cookbook:Lemon Juice|lemon juice]]
* ⅓ cup [[Cookbook:All-purpose flour|all-purpose flour]]
* ½ cup [[Cookbook:Brown Sugar|brown sugar]]
* 1 cup [[Cookbook:Rolled Oats|rolled oats]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 1 teaspoon [[Cookbook:Cinnamon|cinnamon]]
* ¼ cup melted [[Cookbook:Margarine|margarine]] or [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]

== Procedure ==
# Put apple slices in shallow 9-inch (23 cm) pan.
# Sprinkle the apples with lemon juice.
# Combine all dry ingredients with butter and mix until crumbly. Sprinkle all this over apples.
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] at 375 °F (190 °C) for 30 minutes.
